operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero
question: How far do the records the small-book discussion turns on move the adopted model's held-out adverse tail and Vignette 1's stress: the primary, the included-data comparison and the primary without Syndicate 1991, on one fold map and one set of size bands?
reading: influence sensitivities on fixed folds and fixed bands: they do not select the sample, they are not calibration evidence, and the bootstrap summaries are conditional on the computed forecasts

primary.label: the revised primary: the loader's working sample, without the census's rule-8 set-aside records

included_data_643.composition: the primary plus the rule-8 set-aside rows at their pre-census figures; the three records the census corrected (1609_2024, 3330_2017, 3330_2018) are at their census figures, so this is not the earlier 643-record sample
included_data_643.label: the included-data comparison: the primary plus the rule-8 set-aside records at their pre-census figures (643 records); the three corrected records keep their census figures, so this is not the earlier 643-record sample

primary_without_1991.label: the primary without every Syndicate 1991 record (an influence sensitivity)

masks.primary: every base record except the rule-8 set-aside records
masks.included_data_643: every base record (the primary plus the rule-8 set-aside records)
masks.primary_without_1991: the primary less every record of Syndicate 1991

fold_map.rule: the frozen map data/fold_map.json (oos_validation.fold_assignment), dealt once on the 643-record sample's 118 syndicates; the base has 118 of them, and every population takes the map restricted to its own syndicates, so no fold is redealt
fold_map.fold_digest_k10_is: SHA-256 of this base's sorted (syndicate, fold) pairs at k = 10, the restriction of the map to the base; file_sha256 is the map file's own canonical content

fixed_bands.reading: the cutoffs of the earlier 643-record sample, held fixed; reproduced by the included-data base's own quartiles

sampler.retry_rule: a fit that diverges at target_accept is refitted once at target_accept_retry, same seed, and used only if that refit converges (no divergence, max R-hat <= 1.01); the run stops if it does not
sampler.model: adopted_model.scale_block, zero location, gamma fixed at 0, likelihood unweighted

weighting.donor_cdf: every donor row has equal mass, at the fit's posterior means
weighting.bootstrap: uniform Dirichlet over syndicates; a syndicate's weight is shared by its rows and normalised over rows, row mass w_s / sum_t(n_t w_t), not w_s / n_s

exceedance: S_target > the plug-in VaR of the rebuilt pool (strict); expected rate 1 - level

interval.rule: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the replicates' VaRs

primary.reading: conditional on the population's data, the model and the dependence treatment; syndicate reweighting does not correct the posterior's conditional independence; not a total uncertainty and not a paired posterior comparison between populations

interval.rule: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the replicates' VaRs

included_data_643.reading: conditional on the population's data, the model and the dependence treatment; syndicate reweighting does not correct the posterior's conditional independence; not a total uncertainty and not a paired posterior comparison between populations

interval.rule: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the replicates' VaRs

primary_without_1991.reading: conditional on the population's data, the model and the dependence treatment; syndicate reweighting does not correct the posterior's conditional independence; not a total uncertainty and not a paired posterior comparison between populations

excludes.reading: the common targets exclude the 11 rule-8 set-aside rows (in the included-data comparison only) and all 6 Syndicate 1991 targets (not in the third population), so the without-1991 contrast measures Syndicate 1991's effect on the forecasts of other targets only; its own misses are in no common target

bootstrap.weights: uniform Dirichlet over the common targets' syndicates; a syndicate's weight is shared by its rows and normalised over the rows of the group
bootstrap.paired_difference_arithmetic: the per-row difference (new minus old) in the event indicator and the pinball loss is taken first and then weighted; two identical forecasts give exactly zero
bootstrap.reading: a posterior over the average difference under the bootstrap, conditional on the computed forecasts and the observed population: not a total uncertainty, not a paired posterior comparison of the models, and no test

primary_pool_equals_the_vignette_pool.reading: the pool the vignette steps use is the primary's, to the shipped tool's rounding

arrays.reading: <population>__<fold_j|full>__<parameter>: 600 joint posterior draws evenly spaced through the chains; <population>__full_all__<parameter>: every draw of the full fit, chains x draws; <population>__threshold__<rule>__<level>: each target's plug-in VaR, in the order of <population>__keys; <population>__v1_var995_replicates: Vignette 1's bootstrap replicates
